day_shape: 82 items on the third anniversary of October 7: Israeli commemorations dominate, Rubio says Iran lost control of Hormuz while a tanker is reported hit near Qatar, France summons Iran's ambassador over student-protest disinformation, and heavy IRIB/Defa Press output on Tehran mayor Zakani's economic package.

threads.label: October 7 third anniversary commemorations
threads.summary: Israeli outlets, the IDF and Times of Israel marked three years since the Hamas attack with memorial events, archives and designations including Dizengoff Square silence for 1,200 killed and bomb shelters protected as 'antiquities'. Jerusalem Post also covered 412 bereaved IDF partners, former hostages Yarden Bibas and Iair Horn, and criticism of NYC Mayor Mamdani's commemoration speech.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and oil flows
threads.summary: Rubio said Iran had 'lost complete control' of the Strait of Hormuz as Iran International reported tanker captains being paid up to $100,000 a month and $50,000 per-trip bonuses, and China's refiners switching to Iraqi crude. IRIB cited UKMTO reporting a tanker hit by projectiles near Qatar, while a Jerusalem Post post cited an IRGC adviser saying 'illegal routes' in Hormuz would soon be blocked.

threads.label: Iran nuclear talks and Israeli posture
threads.summary: Foreign Minister Araghchi said Iran had presented mediators a 'detailed and operational plan' on its conditions, while Rubio said Tehran had missed repeated chances for a deal. Jerusalem Post reported senior Israeli defence officials warning the Security Cabinet of concern Iran could miscalculate and fire missiles at Israel under continued US economic pressure.

threads.label: Iran economy, rial and sanctions evasion
threads.summary: Iran International reported the central bank offering up to $2 billion in cash dollars to prop up the rial, and an investigation into Bank Parsian's foreign-exchange arm moving millions abroad despite US sanctions. Tehran mayor Zakani was quoted extensively on IRIB and Defa Press promoting a six-package 'zero inflation' subsidy scheme and claiming imported metro buses had 'defeated the American blockade'.

threads.label: France-Iran diplomatic row
threads.summary: France summoned Iran's ambassador over what Paris described as an Iranian disinformation campaign targeting the country's secondary school student protest movement. Defa Press carried Tehran's response, with the foreign ministry spokesman calling the 6 October summons 'baseless' and demanding such 'provocations' end.

threads.label: Iran domestic security and repression
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press reported an armed attack on a police headquarters in Golestan county, with one attacker killed; Iran International covered the family of executed January protester Alireza Raisi saying authorities concealed his burial site, and a protester's account of mock execution. Jerusalem Post reported closures of dozens of cafes over 'pedestrian cruising' and action against theatre companies.

threads.label: Regional proxies and finance
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Hezbollah had received $200 million in cash from Iran despite the US economic chokehold, and a France-US investigation into Hamas using humanitarian and crypto fronts to channel funds. Defa Press reported Hamas and Islamic Jihad leaders meeting in Cairo, and Yemen's Yahya Saree claiming his forces repelled Saudi-backed advances in Al-Jawf, while the UN IOM reported over 200,000 displaced in Yemen.

events.title_en: Muqtada al-Sadr: America should pay compensation for damages inflicted on Iraq. He also called on the American army to compensate for the damages resulting from the occupation of Iraqi territory and sought the filing of legal complaints in this regard.
